paragraphs: AngelTrack sells cloud software to ambulance services, fire departments and medical transport operators. The company presents it as one system rather than several stitched together.

Electronic patient care reporting is described as NEMSIS certified, and the same product carries fire computer aided dispatch and non-emergency transport dispatch. A dispatch planner assigns units through drag-and-drop controls. Quality assurance, narcotics tracking and fire inspections are handled in ways the company says meet HIPAA and NEMSIS standards. For non-emergency transport, a customer portal lets healthcare facilities manage their own bookings, and billing and scheduling sit in the same place.

The company says the platform stretches from small squads to large hospital fleets and is reachable from any device. Its about page describes serving EMS agencies across the United States and abroad. That page also introduces staff in roles such as client support and billing specialist.
